text:
The only legitimate argument to make against SpaceX guidance for both SI and Connectivity is that agentic demand is nearing its S curve slow down in growth. 

If you don’t use it then this seems like a reasonable risk and waiting for an imminent bubble makes sense, if you use agents like grok bot regularly, this is absolutely laughable. Most people simple have not used it enough to feel the how much growth is ahead of us. In that paradigm it’s far more comfortable to explain the excitement from those who use it as tulip mania style hype, than their own time or skill constraints have kept them from seeing the truth.

quoted_tweet.text: This is what Elon was explaining on the SPCX earnings call. Will this last forever?
